verdict.rationale: A probe found a machine-readable OpenAPI file at developer.monday.com/.well-known/openapi.json (HTTP 200, containing an "openapi" key), so a spec can be downloaded. However, monday's primary platform API is documented as GraphQL, and no evidence shows what this OpenAPI file covers or whether a downloadable GraphQL schema exists. That leaves the spec's completeness for the main API unproven. Missing for 10: first-party documentation of the spec download, evidence that the spec covers the full GraphQL platform API (or a downloadable GraphQL schema/SDL), and independent or hands-on corroboration of its use.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can download a machine-readable API spec (OpenAPI or equivalent)

citations.quote: An expressive GraphQL API to interact with your workflows, automate processes, power integrations, and more!
